mechanism: Albuterol is a beta-2 agonist that may cause systemic absorption and sympathomimetic effects, which could theoretically counteract or diminish the alpha-2 adrenergic effects of brimonidine when systemically absorbed.
action: Monitor for reduced brimonidine efficacy in intraocular pressure control; no dose adjustment typically needed but counsel patient on proper ophthalmic instillation technique to minimize systemic absorption.
